product_overview: Massobi is a multilingual HR and payroll platform focused on Saudi and Gulf compliance, combining employee records, payroll processing, attendance, leave, approvals, and compliance reporting in one application. It also includes specialized modules for WPS/SIF, Qiwa, GOSI, Nitaqat, medical insurance, and AI-assisted HR workflows.
core_goals: Manage employee records across branches and departments
Run monthly payroll and review employee pay outcomes
Capture and review attendance, leave, loans, bonuses, expenses, and related HR transactions
Support Saudi compliance workflows including WPS export, GOSI reporting, Qiwa contracts, and Nitaqat analysis
Generate HR and payroll reports in exportable formats
Enable managers and employees to complete approval and self-service tasks within the system
Track company assets, fleet, grievances, training, and performance-related HR processes

features.name: Login and session
features.description: Users authenticate with a username and password to access the application, and remain signed in across reloads while their session is valid.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to / -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See an inline error message
Log in successfully -> Reload the page -> See the session remain active

features.name: Role-based screen gating
features.description: The application shows different navigation options based on the signed-in user role so each role only reaches the screens it is allowed to use.
user_flows: Log in as an admin or hr_manager -> Open the sidebar -> See the full set of available screens
Log in as a finance user -> Open the sidebar -> See only finance-related screens
Log in as a branch_manager -> Open the sidebar -> See branch and attendance-related screens
Log in as an employee_ess user -> Open the sidebar -> See only the ESS screen

tech_stack: React 19 (single-page app, state-based view switching, NO URL router)
Express 4 REST API served from the same origin (server/index.ts, modular server/routes/*)
better-sqlite3 (SQLite, WAL mode) as the only datastore
framer-motion, recharts, lucide-react, jspdf, html2canvas, qrcode

tech_stack.Auth: JWT bearer token persisted in localStorage (key auth_token), role-based screen gating

routes.description: App shell. No URL router exists: while unauthenticated this renders LoginView, after login it renders the sidebar shell and swaps screens via React state (activeView). Refreshing or deep-linking always returns to the dashboard screen, so every screen below is reached by clicking the sidebar, not by URL.
Login form (username + password) rendered at "/" while unauthenticated.
Landing screen after login - headcount, payroll totals, alerts, recent audit activity.
Employee register - list, create, edit, delete, attachments.
Monthly payroll run - generate, sync attendance, lock month, per-employee payslips (WPS).
Daily attendance register with manual punch edits.
Branch kiosk - device pairing, fingerprint/face check-in and check-out.
Leave requests - submit, list, approve/update status.
Bonuses and penalties lines that feed the payroll.
Allowance type catalog used when building employee pay.
Payroll and HR reporting hub with Excel/PDF export.
Salary split reporting (cash vs bank) per company/branch.
Monthly provisions report (end-of-service + leave accruals, IAS 19).
Total cost of employment (TCOE) per employee.
WPS SIF file generation and audit.
Saudi compliance hub - GOSI, Saudization (Nitaqat), document expiry, EOS.
Visas and Muqeem - iqama/work permit renewals, exit-reentry.
Work injury records reported to GOSI.
Disciplinary violation matrix (Saudi labour law article 209) with payroll deduction.
Health, safety and environment inspections and PPE logs.
Kudos feed and rewards redemption catalog.
Exit interview analytics and turnover cost.
Fleet vehicles, traffic fines and deductions.
Company assets and assignment to employees.
Document/alerts expiry hub reached from the header bell.
Organisation, country, currency and statutory rate settings (incl. Saudi GOSI/Nitaqat).
Employee self-service - own payslip, balance, requests, salary certificate.

known_limitations.issue: The app has no URL router. All 59 screens live at "/" and are switched by React state, so deep links, bookmarks and browser refresh always land on the dashboard (or the login form when the token is missing).
known_limitations.impact: A test that navigates by URL will not reach inner screens; navigation must be done by clicking the sidebar.

known_limitations.issue: The database currently holds zero employees and zero payroll rows.
known_limitations.impact: Employee, payroll, attendance and reporting screens render empty tables, so data-driven assertions will be shallow until a few employees exist.

known_limitations.issue: GET /api/documents and POST /api/documents are registered twice in the same module; the second pair (which reads/writes the employee_documents table) is unreachable because Express matches the first registration.
known_limitations.impact: The per-employee documents API silently targets the wrong table; EmployeeDocumentsView reads the documents table.

known_limitations.issue: GET /api/notifications and PUT /api/notifications/read-all are also registered twice in one module.
known_limitations.impact: The second registration is dead code; harmless today but a maintenance trap.

known_limitations.issue: npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) fails with 20 errors.
known_limitations.impact: Type checking is not a working quality gate; 19 of the 20 errors are in the unused Drizzle schema layer.

known_limitations.issue: The src/db/** Drizzle ORM layer (24 files) is dead code - nothing imports it, it references missing modules, and the running server uses raw SQL only.
known_limitations.impact: Misleads readers and breaks the lint gate; safe to delete.

known_limitations.issue: Startup seeding for talent, fleet, flex/telework, grievances, kudos and smart assets fails with SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY.
known_limitations.impact: Those demo datasets are silently empty; affected screens show no sample rows.

known_limitations.issue: Content-Security-Policy is disabled and CORS is wide open, while the JWT is kept in localStorage.
known_limitations.impact: Any XSS would yield a full 24h session token; not a functional defect but a security gap.

known_limitations.issue: Demo accounts are seeded with documented passwords (admin/admin123, hr/hr123, finance/finance123, employee/employee123).
known_limitations.impact: Anyone who reads the repo can sign in with full access until the passwords are changed.

known_limitations.issue: The Cairo web font is imported with an @import that sits after other CSS rules, which browsers ignore.
known_limitations.impact: The intended Arabic font may not load, so text falls back to a default face.

known_limitations.issue: hr-platform/ is an empty Turborepo/Prisma scaffold unrelated to the running app.
known_limitations.impact: Dead structure that suggests a stack the project does not use.
